precedence: This v4 amendment supersedes v3 as the effective central authorization decision wherever v3 left the trusted elevated-session carrier unsealed, named the wrong Gateway test path, or treated only direct CAPABILITY access as activated. Every exact PAGE/DATA tuple, authorization-equivalence key, responseSchemaKey, TIME fresh-command binding, denial and false authority flag from v3 remains in force unless v4 explicitly strengthens it.

gatewayTestPathCorrection.rule: No duplicate ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilterTest may be created under com/dwp/gateway/filter. The established com.dwp.gateway test is the only admitted test for this filter.

elevatedWhenAll: The presented JWT token id resolves to an active, non-revoked, non-expired and non-idle-expired AuthSession row.
The AuthSession userId, tenantId and sessionFamilyId exactly match the authenticated JWT subject, tenant_id and sid.
AuthSession.authenticationMethod is exactly OIDC_STEP_UP after canonical normalization.
AuthSession.assuranceAcr exactly equals the configured dwp.auth.step-up.required-acr value.
AuthSession.assuranceAmr satisfies the existing OidcStepUpAmrPolicy canonical MFA-strength rule.
AuthSession.authenticatedAt is not in the future beyond the existing clock tolerance and is strictly within dwp.auth.step-up.maximum-authentication-age-seconds.
normalDowngradeWhenAny: The current active session contains no step-up assurance.
The ACR is absent or differs from the exact configured required ACR.
The AMR set is absent, malformed or fails the canonical MFA-strength policy.
The assurance is outside the configured maximum age.
trustedElevatedSessionCarrier.invalidSessionRule: A missing or non-active AuthSession row, or a user, tenant or session-family mismatch, remains an authentication failure and must not be converted to NORMAL.
serverOwnership: Auth computes activeAccessMode from the active database session and authenticated JWT; no request field or caller header can select it.
Gateway AuthSessionVerifier accepts only exact NORMAL or ELEVATED values from the successful /auth/me response.
A missing activeAccessMode field is interpreted as NORMAL only for rolling compatibility with an older Auth instance.
A blank, unknown, wrong-type or otherwise malformed activeAccessMode from /auth/me makes identity verification unavailable.
VerifiedIdentity carries the normalized mode to VerifiedIdentityFilter.
VerifiedIdentityFilter removes any caller-supplied X-DWP-Active-Access-Mode header and stores the verified mode only in a server-owned ServerWebExchange attribute.
ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilter reads only the server-owned exchange attribute and never reads an active mode from a request header.
trustedElevatedSessionCarrier.supportSessionPrecedence: When a valid server-owned provider support session is present, ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilter uses PROVIDER_SUPPORT regardless of the tenant session's NORMAL or ELEVATED value. ELEVATED never overrides or relabels PROVIDER_SUPPORT.
failClosedRules: A malformed /auth/me activeAccessMode returns authority unavailable and never reaches an owner service.
A missing exchange attribute after a successful rolling-compatible identity verification is treated as NORMAL, never ELEVATED.
No internal active-mode request header is accepted as evidence, including headers supplied by a browser, reverse proxy or test client.

activatedCapabilityTraversal.activatedCapabilityDefinition: A capability whose lifecycleState is exactly ACTIVE, whose riskTier is HIGH or CRITICAL, and whose non-empty activationPolicy begins with STEPUP-.
activatedCapabilityTraversal.sharedTraversalRule: The generator validator, Auth ProductAuthorizationGateTopologyValidator and Gateway GeneratedProductRouteCatalog must traverse the same complete required-access capability set. Direct CAPABILITY and every member of an ANY or ALL CAPABILITY_EXPRESSION are resolved against the same capability registry; missing capability references fail closed.

expressionEvaluationRule.ANY: Gateway classifies the route as high-risk-step-up-capable when any expression member is activated. Auth still honors ANY: an independently allowed non-activated member may allow the route; when Auth returns STEP_UP_REQUIRED, Gateway must recognize it as a step-up result rather than translate it to authority unavailable.
expressionEvaluationRule.ALL: Gateway classifies the route as high-risk-step-up-capable when any required member is activated. Auth still honors ALL and may challenge only after all non-activation requirements are satisfied; an ordinary deny is never weakened into a challenge.

internalOnlyAuthorityEndpointTopology.preexistingDefectBoundary: The generated v48-and-later authority endpoint hris-navigation-policy-decisions.evaluate is an internal-only endpoint, but the Gateway parser currently applies public-endpoint requirements unconditionally and therefore rejects the bundle before targeted ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilter proof can start.
internalOnlyAuthorityEndpointTopology.parserRule: GeneratedProductRouteCatalog must admit the exact internal-only topology without imposing /api/ or non-blank decision-revision-header requirements. Public endpoints retain those existing requirements.
internalOnlyAuthorityEndpointTopology.lookupRule: An internal-only authority endpoint with null publicPath must never match authorityEndpoint(method, publicPath), route lookup, public namespace derivation or any other public dispatch path. Public lookup must be null-safe and fail closed without dereferencing the null publicPath.
internalOnlyAuthorityEndpointTopology.scopeRule: This is a narrow parser and lookup correction in GeneratedProductRouteCatalog with proof in GeneratedProductRouteCatalogTest. It does not expose a new public route, relax any public endpoint, add authentication bypass, or change the internal service contract.

payRules: Payroll population PAGE and support DATA return a generic step-up challenge in NORMAL and may return data only after ELEVATED reevaluation succeeds.
Payroll run DATA CAPABILITY_EXPRESSION returns a generic step-up challenge rather than 503 and may return data only after ELEVATED reevaluation succeeds.

Payroll prepare and calculate remain ELEVATED-authorized routes with their exact fresh target/version command bindings; the carrier makes ELEVATED reachable but never substitutes for command-bound evidence.
genericAndFreshStepUpTopology.topologyValidatorException: ProductAuthorizationGateTopologyValidator may accept an empty stepUpCommandBindings list only for the exact generic-session-only route closed set above. TIME close/reopen and PAY prepare/calculate must retain their exact fresh bindings; no capability may be split or weakened to evade this rule.
